cover.title: 5 AI Apps for Your Whole Body
cover.subtitle: One app for every signal your body sends.

apps.description: A screen-free band that scores your recovery and strain around the clock, telling you when to push and when to rest.
Point your camera at a meal and it estimates calories and macros instantly — the fastest way to keep nutrition honest.
While the others watch your habits, GainFrame watches the result — reading body-fat % and muscle from a single progress photo.
Personalized run and 5K-to-marathon plans that adjust to how your training is actually going. Your AI cardio coach.
Generates each strength session around the muscles you've recovered and the gear you have. Your AI lifting partner.

caption: The 5 AI fitness apps I actually run in 2026 🤖 Each one owns a different signal — Whoop your recovery, Cal AI your nutrition, Runna your cardio, Fitbod your lifting — and #3, GainFrame, owns your physique, reading body fat and muscle from a single photo. The habit apps tell you what you did; GainFrame tells you if it's working. Free on iOS. #aifitness #fitnessapps #gymtok #bodycomposition #fitnessstack
